name: Okuno-in Temple
heritage: Important Cultural Property of Japan; Historic Site of Japan; part of UNESCO World Heritage Site
text: Okunoin or Oku-no-in (Japanese: 奥之院, lit. 'inner sanctuary') is a sacred Buddhist site and cemetery on Mount Kōya, in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. Opened in 835, it houses the mausoleum of Kūkai, founder of the Shingon school of esoteric Buddhism.

depictions.name: Okunoin Cemetery
depictions.text: Okunoin (奥之院) is a sacred Buddhist site and cemetery east of Kongōbu-ji in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan.
